items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Did you know Burman have a black peep?

ctx.x: Jimmy Johnson. Could that be two different people? Might be. Well they had two Jimmy Johnsons yeah.
I remember that. Did you know Burman have a black peep? Let's both play piano. No.
They might have played after I left. I mean.
